args.message:
Each region's figure is a simple average across its cities, so every city counts the same. A city's revenue is the total of all its order amounts, with no status filter applied. A city is identified by its name together with its region, so Oslo shows up as a separate city in both North and South.

The no-known-region group has two members, averaging 596.65:
- **Paris:** 677.83 from 10 orders. These customers have no region.
- **No city:** 515.47 from 6 orders whose customer_id doesn't match any customer record, so there is no city or region for them. I counted this as one blank city.

The Arctic region has no orders, so it doesn't appear in the results.
